selection_reason: Native multi-round identity-conditioned relational segmentation, native masked appearance/bbox cue, released code and inference checkpoint files satisfy first three review criteria; priority rule selects SegLLM despite porting churn. Release availability is not local execution proof.
inventory_scope: Windows recovered project named files; A6000 project shared/models and code depth2 and named candidates depth3; current project venv pip metadata. Not a server-wide absence claim. Local official-source cache is audit material, not installed baseline.
runtime_smoke: Not run: selected baseline not already runnable; no installation or model download authorized in Cycle014.

candidates.tier_reason: Cannot express the fixed supplied miner identity with its native interface; CMA REF modifications must not be attributed to original LISA.
candidates.native_input: Image and text; generated SEG token decoded by SAM. No native supplied identity mask/region in chat.py.
candidates.output_normalization: Native mask logits thresholded at zero and restored to original image size. Binary export possible, but no CMF identity-trials export.
candidates.local_code_and_checkpoint: Modified LISA code and domain-finetuned w15 checkpoint exist; unmodified official LISA checkpoint not present in scoped recovered model inventory.
candidates.expected_burden: 7B autoregressive LLM plus CLIP and SAM. Planning estimate: single 48GB GPU may suffice at reduced precision; measured memory and latency unknown.
candidates.dependency_interface_blockers: Separate clean baseline config/checkpoint required. Original LLM license terms also apply; HF card license unspecified.
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 repository; upstream model terms separately applicable.

candidates.tier_reason: Supplied miner bbox can encode identity without helmet coordinates; bbox-only cue loses mask shape and is a separate information tier. Relational output is not verified here.
candidates.native_input: Full image and region bboxes through region_enc_processor and model.evaluate(bboxes=...).
candidates.output_normalization: pred_masks logits -> threshold >0 in app.py; map requested grounded phrase to native output using a fixed predeclared native rule, never IoU.
candidates.local_code_and_checkpoint: No GLaMM checkout/weights found in scoped project inventory; external port required.
candidates.expected_burden: 7B LLM, image/region encoders and SAM. Planning estimate: single 48GB GPU may suffice; runtime and peak memory unmeasured.
candidates.dependency_interface_blockers: Legacy LLaVA stack and region encoder; prompt bbox binding and multi-phrase output handling require port verification. Demo inpainting dependency is not needed for segmentation.
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 repository and HF metadata; dependent models retain their own terms.

candidates.tier_reason: Seed native memory lists from supplied miner mask/bbox using condition-matched pixels; identity-conditioned relational task directly comparable. No helmet target needed.
candidates.native_input: Native historical masked RGB crop and bbox, inserted as mask-encode and bbox-encode replacements in multi-round conversation.
candidates.output_normalization: Native segm_loss_mask and segm_loss_boxes; demo takes last mask. Strip native padding via input_size, restore original H/W; existing scorer accepts binary saved arrays.
candidates.local_code_and_checkpoint: Recovered SegLLM-named scripts are REF-LISA experiments and references contain papers, not an installed SegLLM baseline. No remote checkout/weights and detectron2 absent.
candidates.expected_burden: LLaVA-family LLM plus HIPIE/CLIP/BERT. Planning estimate: budget one 48GB GPU; no memory-fit or latency measurement. CUDA compilation/setup is material churn.
candidates.dependency_interface_blockers: Official INSTALL uses Python3.10/CUDA12.4 and two deformable-op builds, HIPIE r50_parts.pth and BERT weights. pyproject has older torch2.0.1/transformers4.31 pins: resolve in isolated env, do not rebuild current CMA env. Verify native yxyx/1024 box convention.
candidates.license: No root LICENSE detected; pyproject advertises Apache classifier, uninext-segm LICENSE is MIT. HF card license unspecified. Clarify coverage before redistribution; do not assert blanket license.

candidates.tier_reason: Supplied miner bbox is a native reference cue; preserve query semantics and document bbox-only information. Spatial prompt alone does not prove success on worn-by relation.
candidates.native_input: Native reference bbox embedded in question; scene/focus/reasoning prompt, predicted target boxes/points feed SAM2.
candidates.output_normalization: SAM2 native predicted-quality choice, original-size Boolean mask union in generate_masks. Never choose boxes or masks by target IoU.
candidates.local_code_and_checkpoint: No RegionReasoner checkout/weights in scoped project inventory; external port required.
candidates.expected_burden: 7B Qwen2.5VL plus SAM2 and optional/default 1.5B router. Planning estimate: one 48GB GPU candidate; actual memory/latency unknown.
candidates.dependency_interface_blockers: SAM2 absent; separate Qwen/FlashAttention stack and router weights. Constructor default names VisionReasoner: explicitly override with RegionReasoner checkpoint. Verify reference coordinate scaling.
candidates.license: Repository API and HF card expose no explicit license; redistribution terms unresolved.

candidates.tier_reason: Native tokens can represent supplied miner mask without helmet labels. Combined region-conditioned helmet generation is an interface-level inference, not an executed demo in this audit.
candidates.native_input: Native VQ-SAM2 maps supplied mask/box/image to mask tokens; VLM consumes those tokens and can generate mask tokens decoded into 2D masks.
candidates.output_normalization: Generated mask tokens -> VQ-SAM2 decoder -> 2D masks, restored to original size; fixed native decoding then binary export.
candidates.local_code_and_checkpoint: No SAMTok checkout/weights in scoped project inventory; external port required.
candidates.expected_burden: 8B Qwen3VL plus SAM2.1 and mask tokenizer. Planning estimate: single 48GB GPU candidate at BF16, runtime/fit unmeasured.
candidates.dependency_interface_blockers: New Qwen3VL-compatible transformers plus mask_tokenizer_256x2.pth and sam2.1_hiera_large.pt; current environment lacks SAM2. Native mask-understanding demo is captioning; combined relational mask-generation needs wiring verification.
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 repository and selected HF metadata; third-party component terms remain applicable.
